mapper.select: SELECT FROM reports r JOIN projects p ON p.id=r.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM reports r JOIN projects p ON p.id=r.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE r.id=#{id} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET title=COALESCE(#{title},title), status=COALESCE(#{status},status), version_no=COALESCE(#{versionNo},version_no), lead=COALESCE(#{lead},lead), summary=COALESCE(#{summary},summary), recommendation=COALESCE(#{recommendation},recommendation), recommendation_detail=COALESCE(#{recommendationDetail},recommendation_detail), citations=COALESCE(#{citations},citations), content=COALESCE(#{content},content), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
